content.rendered:
Due to the winter weather, Sherwood School District has announced they will be on a two-hour delay schedule for today, Monday April 11, 2022. As we follow the district’s closure decisions, SCS will also be on a two- hour delay. Car line begins at 9:40 am, school will begin at 10 am.
Thanks!
